description: Hand a Pi session over between Claude/Codex windows. save (when the user asks to hand over): record the repository cwd, the sessionId, and a short goal, completed and next. read (when the user asks to pick up a project): returns the latest note for cwd (or the one named), plus resumeHint and howToResume, computed from the session's live state. Follow resumeHint, then use status/wait/follow_up as usual. A note is a summary, not the session's state; it never claims, recovers or deletes a session. remainingTurns/canFollowUp describe state and turn-budget readiness only.

completed.description: save: what is done, including results a new window needs

cwd.description: Absolute path of the repository. save: the session's own cwd, exactly as it was spawned with

goal.description: save: what the work is for

name.description: Optional label to keep several handoffs per repository; read defaults to the newest

sessionId.description: save: the Pi session to hand over

name: handoff
